dogecoin.text: @RussellRukin @SatoshiDoodles @PurseIO @dogecoin Actually, before you answer, I will concede that the one thing BTC does better is memes.

@RussellRukin @SatoshiDoodles @PurseIO @dogecoin I run BTC and BCH nodes, it's not a big deal. Even with 100x growth, running BCH nodes will be easy to do at home for quite a while. You keep slandering BCH but provide no evidence for your claims. What do you think BTC does better than BCH.  Please be specific.

@RussellRukin @SatoshiDoodles @PurseIO @dogecoin No offense to dogecoin, but it is not derived from the genesis block and is not what I invested in years ago. At least BTC is derived from the GB, but it has stayed far from electronic cash. BCH: genesis block, 21E6 coin limit, spendable as cash--that's the Bitcoin I invested in.

@stateofsatoshi @PurseIO @RussellRukin @SatoshiDoodles @dogecoin It is the responsibility of the person making the claim to provide evidence to support that claim, not  the responsibility of others to provide evidence refuting the claim.  This is known as burden of proof, and is basic reasoning.  This is an error I see with many on Twitter.

@stateofsatoshi @PurseIO @RussellRukin @SatoshiDoodles @dogecoin @stateofsatoshi What are you rambling on about? You claimed Purse was paid to support BCH. I asked if you had evidence for the claim.  Your response does not address that at all.

@stateofsatoshi @PurseIO @RussellRukin @SatoshiDoodles @dogecoin make of car?  Good products don't derive their value from the shaming of people who choose a different product. That's not what gives gold or dollars their value. The only things that work that way are religion, nationalism, racism...
@RussellRukin @PurseIO @SatoshiDoodles @dogecoin 1 mb blocks: such a bad, arbitrary policy.
@Kramerwhale @RussellRukin @SatoshiDoodles @PurseIO @dogecoin That's not the long term plan at all.
@RussellRukin @BTCorBCH @SatoshiDoodles @PurseIO @dogecoin BTW, have you actually tried LN yet?  Curious since you run your own node...

@RussellRukin @BTCorBCH @SatoshiDoodles @PurseIO @dogecoin And BCH has doubled against BTC since its all-time low.  See how easy that was when I can just choose any point of the data I want? That's why averages are used...to avoid cherry-picking.

@RussellRukin @BTCorBCH @SatoshiDoodles @PurseIO @dogecoin Your cherry-picked data are a good indication of you intellectual honestly.  While not a false statement, your claim is incredibly misleading. 100 day EMA provides much more reliable data and shows BCH up 30% against BTC since the hard fork.
@RussellRukin @BTCorBCH @SatoshiDoodles @PurseIO @dogecoin That's usually what these arguments boil down to, isn't it.  Good thing economics will choose a winner.

@stateofsatoshi @PurseIO @RussellRukin @SatoshiDoodles @dogecoin In summary, you made a claim that purse was bribed, stating it as a fact which you provided no evidence to support, expecting others to provide evidence to disapprove your self-assured claim. Despite repeated requests to provide evidence, you did not; nor did you appear 1/n

@stateofsatoshi @PurseIO @RussellRukin @SatoshiDoodles @dogecoin "I also provided evidence..." I saw no evidence presented that purse was paid to accept BCH. Please feel free to explain again the evidence you intended to present. 

"You'll...support BCH regardless of marketing..." I support what I like, based on the evidence.
